data.key: Spellscar Drifter ~ Weapon and Armor Proficiency
data.name: Weapon and Armor Proficiency
data.description: Spellscar drifters are proficient with all simple and martial weapons, the whip, and with all firearms. They are proficient with all light armor. This replaces the cavalier's normal weapon and armor proficiencies.
